title: Xyvox's Resource Pack
description: The resource pack from the famous YouTuber Xyvox_ completely made him.
body:
An exclusive Resource Pack from YouTuber Xyvox!

Xyvox is a YouTuber and Minecraft server creator. With 1,400 YouTube subscribers, he created a resource pack to celebrate the launch of Season 3 on his server (celest-mc.fr).

What you'll find:

Refined textures for a cleaner, more visually appealing look
A graphic style consistent with Xyvox's universe
Reworked details to make every element of the game more vibrant
A smooth experience for playing or watching his videos

Whether you're a Xyvox fan or simply looking for a unique resource pack, this one will truly revitalize your game, especially in PvP!

Download it below and rediscover Minecraft in a whole new way!
